strings.name: André Esteves
strings.summary: Esteves began in Pactual's technology department before moving into trading and bank management. He helped found BTG and create BTG Pactual through the repurchase of Pactual. He resigned his leadership posts after a 2015 arrest on suspicion of obstructing justice, was acquitted in that case in 2018 and returned as chairman in 2022. He also supports technology education and philanthropy.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped establish and develop BTG Pactual, expanding Latin American investment banking and asset management.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied computer science at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro, earning a bachelor's degree.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Helped shape BTG Pactual
strings.highlights.h1.text: Went through Pactual's sale to UBS, departure to found BTG and the repurchase of Pactual, helping establish a financial group spanning investment banking and asset management.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Technology education and philanthropy
strings.highlights.h2.text: As a co-founder and supporter of the nonprofit technology education institution Inteli, contributes to initiatives in education, the environment and healthcare.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed Brazilian fiscal policy
strings.timeline.t1.text: Speaking at IDP Debates, argued that necessary fiscal adjustment could be compatible with President Lula's campaign promises. UOL reported his remarks on 13 November.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Shareholders approved his return as chairman
strings.timeline.t2.text: BTG Pactual shareholders approved his appointment as chairman. Having returned to the bank in a non-management role in 2016, he resumed formal board leadership.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Acquitted in the obstruction case
strings.timeline.t3.text: A Brazilian federal court acquitted him in the Car Wash-related obstruction-of-justice case because of insufficient evidence.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Arrested and left bank leadership
strings.timeline.t4.text: Arrested on suspicion of obstructing an investigation, then resigned as BTG Pactual CEO and chairman. He was released after 23 days in custody; the case later proceeded through the courts.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Repurchased Pactual to form the new group
strings.timeline.t5.text: BTG bought Pactual back from UBS to form BTG Pactual, restoring an independent banking platform and continuing investment banking and asset management development.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Left UBS and founded BTG
strings.timeline.t6.text: Left UBS with partners and established BTG Investments, laying the groundwork for the subsequent Pactual repurchase and rebuilding of the banking platform.
strings.timeline.t7.title: UBS acquired Pactual
strings.timeline.t7.text: Following Pactual's sale to UBS, became CEO and chairman of UBS Pactual, moving into a multinational banking group.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered Pactual through technology
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined Pactual in a technology role, later moving into fixed income and becoming a partner, extending his computing background into trading and bank management.
